title: Drowned Causeway
contentBrief: Exactly four medieval adventurers, all seen from behind, stand ankle-deep on a broken stone causeway through a flooded reed marsh in thin rain. Drowned posts, exposed roots, mud, black water, and pale marsh flowers lead to one narrow leaning stone tower on a low island with one amber window. Heavy indigo storm clouds part over a vermilion-gold sunset; night is close.
poseBrief: The party is grouped naturally in the central portion of the frame: a broad fighter with shield and sword, a lean jack-of-all-trades with bow, rope, satchel, tools, and map case, a tall scholarly mage with a crooked staff, and a shorter field mage with a shuttered arcane lantern. All four face the tower; quieter upper-left sky remains available for the live page heading.
alt: Four adventurers cross a rain-soaked marsh toward a lonely candlelit tower at sunset while a creature lurks behind a dead tree.
constraints: Exactly four adventurers and one tower; no front-facing figures, extra people, fire, lightning, logos, readable text, watermark, frame, border, or panel divisions.
